scope: POST HOC symptom-vector-group-disjoint evaluation on processed synthetic data; NOT the historical test partition
split_procedure: Two GroupShuffleSplit calls (test group fraction 0.15, then validation fraction 0.15/0.85 of remaining groups); not exactly stratified by record-level disease labels
notes: The previous 89.60% published accuracy used a different split. Accuracy differences are descriptive, not causal effects of grouping.
Identical feature vectors, including those with different disease labels, never cross train/validation/test.
Near-similar vectors (Hamming distance=1) may still cross partitions.
The class proportions and exact record split sizes can differ because GroupShuffleSplit partitions groups, not records.
The bootstrap CI accounts for test-side identical-vector clustering but not training variability or synthetic-data limitations.
Preselected 100 disease categories and feature representation came from the original study. No fresh external dataset was used.
